name: River Bridge Event Center
description: A wedding venue in Spanish Fork with an indoor reception hall, indoor and outdoor ceremony locations, a covered patio and pavilion, a lawn with a water feature and mountain views on the Spanish Fork River trail; rentals include furniture, sound, setup and cleanup.

Features > Cleanup crew.wording: Cleanup at the end of the evening

Features > Linens included.wording: 12 runners + 8 full length linens for full day rental

Features > Outdoors.wording: Outdoor ceremony locations | Covered patio | Lawn area

Features > Sparklers allowed.wording: Sparkler package, $100 (100 sparklers; venue lights and disposes)
